docs.title: Superseded documents
docs.text:
The documents below were also collected but are older than a document listed above, so the site does not follow them.

Document Date Replaced by 표본코호트DB 2.2 레이아웃 September 2021, data through 2019 The NSC table layout of May 2026, which covers the same release with data through 2023 despite the version number missing from its file name 맞춤형 자료 제공 컬럼 레이아웃 August 7, 2024 The customized DB layout of September 10, 2026 장기요양 자료 제공 컬럼 레이아웃 July 31, 2024 The long-term care layout of September 10, 2026

The changes between the 2024 and 2026 layouts of the customized DB are listed on the Customized Research DB page.

docs.title: Conflicts between sources
docs.text:
Where NHIS documents disagree, the site states both versions and marks the entry rather than choosing silently. The conflicts found so far are listed below.

  • Cause of death in the Senior Cohort. The Senior manual lists two cause-of-death variables, while the portal and the 2024 guide to new applications state that the database has none. See the Senior Cohort page.
  • Sampling of the Senior Cohort. The Senior manual describes stratified sampling in one section and simple random sampling in another. See the Senior Cohort page.
  • Family history in the National Sample Cohort, 2018 to 2023. The layout file codes these questions 1 and 2, while the manual text and the customized DB layout code them 0 and 1. The five variables are marked Disputed, as in Q_FHX_HTN.
  • Triglycerides in the Low-Risk Sample Dataset. The manual gives the formula for calculated LDL cholesterol under triglycerides. See the Low-Risk Sample Dataset page.
  • Requestable years for the customized DB. The 2024 guide allows requests through 2023, and the 2026 application form allows requests through 2024. The site follows the 2026 form.

docs.title: Corrections in the codebook
docs.text:
The layout files and manuals are written to be read as printed tables, so a few cells do not survive a mechanical import. The importer corrects the cases below, and each affected variable page carries a note that describes the correction.

  • Admission route. The cohort manuals list the two digits of the admission route separately, and the codebook lists the combined codes 11 to 32 with the labels of the customized DB layout, as in HSPTZ_PATH_TYPE.
  • Shared description cells. In the 2018 to 2023 screening layout of the National Sample Cohort, one description cell spans several rows, such as the unit and missing-value rule of six blood tests. The description is applied to every row it spans, as in G1E_VA_LT.
  • Year markers. Notes such as 2018년 or 2019부터 적용 next to a code list are applied to the years of the entry, and a cell that lists two code sets for different years is split into two periods.
  • Codes outside their row. The codes of the 2002 to 2008 past-history questions in the National Sample Cohort sit in one shared note, and they are attached to each of the nine variables.
  • Codes that do not apply. The layout repeats yes and no codes for the free-text field Q_AWR_DZ, and these are omitted.
  • Duplicate codes. Six variables list one code with two meanings in the same years, as in GOE_JDG. These are reproduced as printed with a note, since the documents give no way to tell which meaning applies.

The importer does not invent codes the documents leave out. The long-term care assessment items (T02) of the National Sample Cohort and the Senior Cohort, for example, refer to the response categories of the assessment form printed in the manual, and their numeric codes are not documented.

  1. The manual refers to the national statistics agency as 국가데이터처, the name that Statistics Korea took in October 2025, so it was written after that date. ↩

docs.title: Program and data
docs.text:
Understanding the data starts with the program that generates it. Every record in the NHIS databases is a by-product of enrolling people, collecting premiums, paying claims, or running the national health screening program, and each of these processes shapes what the data can and cannot measure.

  • The health insurance system describes who is covered, how benefits and cost sharing work, and how the NHIS differs from the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service (HIRA).
  • NHIS research databases lists the databases available to researchers.
  • Applying for data describes the application, review, and analysis environment.

docs.title: Applying for data
docs.text:
Applications are submitted through the NHIS data sharing service (건강보험자료공유서비스) at nhiss.nhis.or.kr. The portal handles the application, the review, and payment, but it says little about how long each stage takes or what reviewers look for, so this page records what applicants have learned.

The questions of the application appear only after logging in and starting a request, so this page lists them in advance. Most of the answers, and the research summary in particular, can then be drafted before the portal is opened and before the IRB application is written, since both must describe the same study.

Write the application and the IRB protocol in Korean

The research summary, the drug research plan, and the IRB protocol attached to the application should all be written in Korean. An application whose IRB protocol was written in English has been rejected. Researchers whose IRB approval comes from a review board abroad, or was written in English, should prepare Korean versions of the documents before applying.

Sources

This page follows the NHIS guide to new applications (사용자매뉴얼1, 연구용DB 신규신청 방법, version 4.0, September 2024), the NHIS notice on researcher extraction of customized DBs (맞춤형 DB 제공 방식 변경 안내, July 2025), the customized DB request form of 2026, and the portal as seen by applicants in 2026. The portal changes from time to time, so the wording of a question may differ slightly from the wording here.

docs.title: Steps of an application
docs.text:
An application is entered on the portal under 연구과제, 연구DB 신청, in six steps. Steps 1 to 4 and step 6 are the same for the sample and customized databases, and step 5 applies to customized DBs only.

Step 한글 Content 1 신청서류 작성 Applicant type, research type, requests to the NHIS, and linkage with data of other institutions 2 IRB서류 첨부 및 사용기간 설정 IRB approval notice and protocol, and the period of data use 3 연구과제요약서 작성 Research summary, which the review committee reads, and the drug or medical device plan if needed 4 연구원 등록 Principal investigator, co-investigators, and research assistants 5 데이터셋 추출 방식 설정 Extraction method, study population, tables, and variables, described on the customized DB page 6 본인인증 및 신청 완료 Identity verification by every registered researcher

docs.title: Step 1. Application documents
docs.text:
The first screen classifies the project and collects requests to the NHIS.

Question 한글 Options and notes Applicant type 신청자 유형 Government ministry (정부부처), public institution (공공기관), public research institution (공공연구기관), or other research such as private companies (기타연구, 민간기업). Universities and hospitals choose public research institution. Part-time expert 비상근전문위원 참여여부 Yes only when the principal investigator is designated as an NHIS big data research expert (빅데이터 연구 전문위원) Research type 연구유형 Policy research, academic research, thesis, joint research, scientific research, or other research (기타연구). The next table describes each type except other research, which the guide does not describe. Special research 특수연구구분 General (일반), or COVID-19 (코로나) for the COVID-19 database Requests and other notes 요청사항/기타 Free text of up to 4,000 bytes. Customized DB applications must state who will extract the data, the preferred extraction site (Wonju or Seoul), and whether that person has extracted NHIS data before. Linkage with other institutions 타기관 연계여부 Customized DB policy research only, with a clear legal basis and a phone consultation before applying

The research type determines the documents to attach.

Research type 한글 Purpose and required documents Policy research 정책연구 A policy research report. Attach the research contract and supporting documents, and the commissioning agency must send an official letter to the NHIS before the review. Academic research 학술연구 Journal articles. Additional use (추가활용) gives a new project number, without a new extract, to the same principal investigator for further results within the scope already approved. Thesis 학위논문 A thesis or dissertation. Attach a certificate of enrollment issued within three months of the application. Joint research 공동연구 Research under an agreement with the NHIS, such as a memorandum of understanding. An agreement signed with another NHIS department requires that department to send an official letter to the big data office (빅데이터연구개발실). Scientific research 과학적연구 Research applying scientific methods, such as technology development and demonstration, basic and applied research, and privately funded research. Attach a scientific research use plan (과학적 연구 활용계획서).

Since September 2025, customized DBs are provided only through researcher extraction (연구자 추출), in which the researcher builds the extract in SAS on an NHIS computer during a fixed window after approval. The title of such a project starts with [연구자 추출], as in [연구자 추출] 심방세동 환자의 후유증 분석 연구, and this applies to additional use as well. First-time extractors must work in Wonju and attend training on the first day, while Seoul is open only to researchers who have extracted before.

docs.title: Step 2. IRB documents and period of use
docs.text:
The application needs the approval notice (IRB 결과통지서) from an institutional review board or from the public institutional review board (공용기관생명윤리위원회), together with the research protocol (IRB 연구계획서) submitted to that board. The notice must carry the seal of the issuing institution or the signature of its head, and an application whose documents cannot be verified is returned. The protocol should be in Korean, since an application with an English protocol has been rejected.

The period of data use is set on the same screen and can be reset when the fee notice is issued. The analysis tool is chosen here for a sample database and after approval for a customized DB.

The title, the principal investigator, and the study on the portal must match the IRB documents. Writing the research summary before the IRB protocol therefore saves a second round of edits, because the protocol can reuse the same text.

docs.title: Step 3. Research summary
docs.text:
The research summary (연구과제요약서) is the text the data provision review committee reads, since the summary entered on the portal is placed on the committee agenda as written. It is written in Korean, and the guide asks for detailed prose and names three kinds of summaries that are sent back for revision.

  • A list of variables or diagnosis codes from which the study cannot be understood
  • A summary without a clear theoretical basis for the planned research
  • An outline-style summary that needs further explanation

The summary has the fields below. Free-text fields are limited in bytes, as explained after the table.

Field 한글 Limit What the NHIS asks for Research type 연구타입 Checkbox Drug research (약제연구) or medical device research (치료재료연구), each opening its own plan. Drug research is required for the prescription table (T60). Title 연구명 500 characters The same title as on the IRB approval notice and protocol, with [연구자 추출] in front for customized DBs Requested years 요청년도 Menu The years of data requested, which must match the years chosen in step 5. The 2024 guide allowed years up to 2023, and the 2026 request form allows years up to 2024. Requested data 요청자료 Buttons Eligibility (자격DB), claims (진료DB), screening (검진DB), providers (요양기관DB), death (사망DB), and other (기타). The cause-of-death database (통계청사망원인DB) and any additional table, such as the cancer screening DB, are written under other. Research topic 연구주제(대상질환) 4,000 bytes The topic and the target diseases. The guide's model answer is a single line listing the diseases and the test studied. Research purpose 연구목적 4,000 bytes The background of the study, its hypotheses, and what it aims to achieve Study population 자료추출을 위한 대상자 정의 4,000 bytes The definition of the study population, identical to the one set on the portal or in the Excel request form, with codes and years Research content 연구내용 4,000 bytes What will be done with the requested data, including the background, hypotheses, and operational definitions of the study population and variables. Policy research with linked data also describes the linked data here or under methods. Research methods 연구방법 4,000 bytes The theoretical and statistical methods for testing the hypotheses with the requested data, and the reason for each additional table, written as OO DB 요청사유 followed by the reason and the planned use Expected outcomes and uses 기대효과/활용방안 4,000 bytes The expected results and how they will be used Funding source 연구비지원 출처 4,000 bytes The exact source of funding, or 해당 없음 when there is none

The portal adds three notes above these fields. The database has no income variable, and premium quantiles are offered in its place. A project that requests the cause-of-death database must also apply on the Statistics Korea website after the NHIS approval. The research content and methods should be written in detail.

The guide's model answers come from a study of claims for next-generation sequencing tests. Its research content is a numbered outline of the planned analyses, with the variables of each, and its research methods are prose paragraphs that take the analyses one at a time.

The summary must stay within what the NHIS provides, so it cannot rely on variables the database does not hold, such as income or education level. Each additional table needs its own stated reason under research methods, and listing its variables does not count as a reason.

docs.title: Byte limits
docs.text:
The counters under each field count bytes, not characters. A Hangul character counts as 3 bytes, and a space, digit, or Latin letter as 1, which is the same as the UTF-8 encoding. Dense Korean prose averages a little over 2 bytes per character once spaces are included, so a 4,000-byte field holds about 1,700 characters and a 2,000-byte field about 850.

Drafting the answers in a word processor and counting them before pasting avoids having to cut text on the portal. In Python, len(text.encode("utf-8")) gives the count. The guide does not say how line breaks are counted, so it is safer to leave a margin of a hundred bytes or so.

docs.title: Drug research plan
docs.text:
A request for prescription details (T60) requires a drug research plan (약제연구 활용계획서) and a drug list in the NHIS template (약제목록 서식). The template and an example of how to fill it in are downloaded from the drug list guide button (약제목록 작성 안내) at the bottom of the plan. A file that does not follow the template cannot be uploaded, and drugs missing from the plan or the list are not provided.

The NHIS asks for only the drugs related to the topic, requested at the coarsest level the study allows, such as groups or the first four digits of the ingredient code. A project that does not request T60 must untick the table in step 5.

The plan opens with screening questions about single-listed drugs (단독등재 약제), meaning ingredients with a single supplier at the level of the first four digits of the ingredient code. Each answer sends the applicant to a different item.

Item Question If yes If no 1 Does the request include single-listed drugs? 2-1 3-3 2-1 Are single-listed drugs to be grouped so that no single company's information is exposed? 3-3 3-1 3-1 Do single-listed drugs affect the analysis of results, because they are used to analyze effectiveness or safety? 3-2 3-3 3-2 Can a summary of a prior meta-analysis of the requested single-listed drugs be submitted? 3-3 3-3

Grouping means requesting a single-listed drug together with other ingredient codes so that every group has at least two suppliers. For item 3-1, the form explains that the answer is yes when the drug is an independent variable that affects the outcome and no when the drug only defines the study population or covariates. The template for the meta-analysis summary is posted on the portal notice board (고객지원, 공지사항, 논문 요약서 서식).

Item 3-3 consists of four text fields, two of which have half the usual limit.

Field 한글 Limit Required content Drug status 약제현황 4,000 bytes The requested drugs and the reason for each, at least by therapeutic class, described in general terms rather than as a list of ingredient codes Other information 기타사항 4,000 bytes The request unit, by default the first four digits of the ingredient code or a grouping proposed by the researcher, with a reason for five digits or more, and whether single-listed products fall within it Research scope 연구범위 2,000 bytes The background, hypotheses, and scope of the drug research Analysis and use plan 분석 및 활용계획 2,000 bytes How each drug will be used (as a covariate, to define a disease, to select the study population, or to analyze effectiveness), and whether and at what level (class, group, or ingredient) drugs will be compared in their association with outcomes

A study that does not compare drugs in their association with outcomes says so in the analysis and use plan with a fixed sentence, 약제와 결과변수와의 연관성 비교분석을 시행하지 않는다. The plan for medical device research (치료재료연구 활용계획서) follows a similar format and is not covered here.

docs.title: Step 4. Researchers
docs.text: The principal investigator must be a Korean national living in Korea and must be the person named as principal investigator on the IRB approval notice. For a thesis, the student registers as principal investigator, and the advisor named on the IRB notice registers as co-investigator. Every researcher added to the project needs an account on the portal.

docs.title: Step 6. Identity verification and submission
docs.text:
The application is not submitted until every registered researcher verifies their identity by both mobile phone and email, and the verification must be repeated for each application. The application is submitted automatically when the last researcher finishes, and its status changes to awaiting receipt (접수대기).

When NHIS staff receive the application, the status changes to awaiting review (검토대기). If anything must be supplemented before the review, the status becomes supplement requested (보완요청), and the applicant revises the application from the project list (나의과제) and submits it again. For customized DBs under researcher extraction, the review committee meets twice a month, and an approved application changes to awaiting construction (자료구축대기).

docs.title: Export review
docs.text: Results can leave the analysis environment only after passing the NHIS export review (반출 심사).

docs.title: NHIS research databases
docs.text: The NHIS releases two kinds of research data, namely ready-made sample databases and customized databases extracted for a specific study. All of them are drawn from the National Health Information Database (국민건강정보DB), which holds eligibility, claims, health screening, and death records for the whole population.

docs.title: Sample databases
docs.text:
The sample databases (표본연구DB) are fixed samples, and three of them follow the same people over many years. They are the usual starting point because they are cheaper and faster to obtain than a customized extract.

Database 한글 Population Sample Years Cohort profile National Sample Cohort (NHIS-NSC) 표본코호트DB Enrolled throughout 2006, all ages 1,000,000 2002-2023 Lee et al. (2017)1 Health Screening Cohort (NHIS-HEALS) 건강검진코호트DB Aged 40 to 79 and screened in 2002 or 2003 514,866 2002-2023 Seong et al. (2017) Senior Cohort (NHIS-Senior) 노인코호트DB Aged 60 to 80 and enrolled in 2008 511,953 2002-2023 Kim et al. (2019)1 Low-Risk Sample Dataset 저위험 표본데이터셋 Used medical care in 2014 to 2023 1,000,000 2014-2023 None

The NHISS portal also lists an educational sample research DB (교육용 표본연구DB), which is not yet documented here. The Datasets section compares the databases in detail.

docs.title: Customized research databases
docs.text:
A customized research DB (맞춤형연구DB) is extracted from the full National Health Information Database to match the population and variables of an approved research protocol. It can cover everyone who meets the study criteria rather than a sample, at the cost of a longer review and analysis at an NHIS analysis center.

Full citations for the cohort profiles are on the references page.

  1. These cohort profiles describe earlier releases. Lee et al. (2017) describe release 1.0 of the National Sample Cohort, drawn from the 2002 population, and Kim et al. (2019) describe release 1.0 of the Senior Cohort, drawn from people aged 60 and older in 2002. ↩↩

docs.title: The health insurance system
docs.text: Korea has a single public insurer, the National Health Insurance Service (NHIS), which covers almost the entire population. Coverage became universal in 1989, and the many separate insurance societies were merged into a single insurer in 2000. Because every resident is enrolled with the same insurer, the NHIS data follow people across jobs, regions, and providers without the gaps that arise when people switch insurers.

docs.title: Who is covered
docs.text:
The population falls into six groups, and the group a person belongs to determines how their premium is set and how they appear in the data.

  • Employee insured (직장가입자) are wage workers and their employers, who pay premiums based on wages. A business owner with at least one employee is an employee insured, while an owner without employees is a self-employed insured.
  • Dependents of employee insured (직장피부양자) are family members of employee insured who meet income and property conditions, and who pay no premium of their own.
  • Self-employed heads of household (지역세대주) head the households of everyone not covered as an employee insured, as a dependent, or by Medical Aid. These households are self-employed insured (지역가입자), and their premium is set for the household as a whole, based on its income and property.
  • Self-employed household members (지역세대원) are the other members of these households, whose income and property count toward the household premium.
  • Medical Aid heads of household (의료급여세대주) head low-income households that are covered by Medical Aid (의료급여) rather than health insurance, and pay no premium.
  • Medical Aid household members (의료급여세대원) are the other members of these households.

Medical Aid is financed by the government and has its own cost-sharing rules, but its beneficiaries also appear in the NHIS eligibility data. The six groups are the codes of the insurance type variable in the eligibility tables, such as GAIBJA_TYPE (건강보험 가입자격 구분, insurance type) in the National Sample Cohort.

docs.title: Benefits and cost sharing
docs.text: Services are divided into covered services (급여), which are billed to the insurer with patient cost sharing, and non-covered services (비급여), which patients pay for entirely out of pocket. Only covered services are billed to the insurer, so non-covered services do not appear in the claims data. This matters for any measure of total spending, since the share of non-covered services varies across conditions, provider types, and years.

docs.title: The NHIS and HIRA
docs.text:
Two public agencies handle claims, and both release research data. Providers submit claims to the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service (HIRA, 건강보험심사평가원), which reviews them and passes the decisions to the NHIS for payment. The two agencies therefore hold overlapping claims records, but only the NHIS holds enrollment, premium, health screening, and linked death records.

NHIS HIRA Role Insurer, collects premiums and pays providers Reviews claims and assesses quality of care Enrollment and premium data Yes No Health screening results Yes No Death records Linked from Statistics Korea No Claims Yes Yes

docs.title: Health screening
docs.text: The NHIS runs the national health screening program (국가건강검진), and screening results are available in several research databases. Most adults are invited for a general health screening every two years, while non-office workers are screened every year, and separate programs cover cancer screening and infants and children.

docs.title: Long-term care
docs.text: The NHIS also administers long-term care insurance for older adults (노인장기요양보험), introduced in July 2008.

docs.title: Variables
docs.text:
This section documents every table and variable of each NHIS research database. It currently covers 4,808 variables in 5 datasets. Choose a dataset to see all its variables grouped by table, then select a variable to see its Korean and English names, its description, and the meaning of each code.

Dataset 한글 Years Tables Variables National Sample Cohort 표본코호트DB 2002-2023 12 369 National Health Screening Cohort 건강검진코호트DB 2002-2023 11 458 Senior Cohort 노인코호트DB 2002-2023 11 391 Low-Risk Sample Dataset 저위험 표본데이터셋 2014-2023 2 37 Customized Research DB 맞춤형연구DB 2002-2024 31 3,553

The English names and descriptions are translations made for this site. The Korean original is shown next to each translation, and it is the authoritative text. Corrections are welcome, as described in Contributing.

Search for a variable name such as RN_INDI or a Korean label such as 주상병 with the search bar.

[Questionnaire 11] Does the child speak as well as other children of the same age? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q1_VF2104 [영양교육1. 아이가 건강한 식습관을 가지고 있습니까? [Nutrition education 1] Does the child have healthy eating habits? 2021 I7Q_AUD_Q3_VF1507 [문진12] 반복되는 중이염(급성중이염을 6개월간 4회 이상, 1년간 6회 이상 앓은 경우)을 앓은 적이 있습니까? [Questionnaire 12] Has the child had recurrent otitis media (acute otitis media 4 or more times in 6 months, or 6 or more times in a year)? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q2_VF2104 [영양교육2. 아이가 매일 아침식사를 합니까? [Nutrition education 2] Does the child eat breakfast every day? 2021 I7Q_AUD_Q4_VF1507 [문진13] 아이가 이전보다 소리에 대한 반응이 둔해지거나 (뒤에서 불러도 돌아보지 않거나), TV 소리를 더 크게 하고 보는 경향이 있습니까? [Questionnaire 13] Has the child become less responsive to sounds than before (not turning when called from behind), or tend to turn up the TV volume? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q3_VF2104 [영양교육3. 아이가 물 대신 음료수, 과일주스를 선호하여 자주 마십니까? [Nutrition education 3] Does the child often drink soft drinks or fruit juice in preference to water? 2021 I7Q_AUD_Q5_VF1507 [문진14] 조용한 곳에서 아이 뒤로 한팔 정도 떨어져, 아이 한쪽 귀를 번갈아 막고 속삭이듯이 단어(연필, 학교 등)를 말하면, 양쪽 모두 정확하게 따라 말할 수 있습니까? [Questionnaire 14] In a quiet place, standing an arm's length behind the child and covering each ear in turn, if you whisper a word (pencil, school), can the child repeat it correctly with both ears? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q4_VF2104 [영양교육4. 아이가 매일 유제품(우유, 플레인 요거트, 치즈 등)을 먹습니까? [Nutrition education 4] Does the child eat dairy products (milk, plain yogurt, cheese) every day? 2021 I7Q_SFT_Q1_VF1507 [문진20] 차에 탈 때마다 아이를 보조의자에 앉히고 안전띠를 매어줍니까? [Questionnaire 20] Do you seat the child in a booster seat with a seat belt every time in the car? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q5_VF2104 [영양교육5. 아이가 일반우유 대신 저지방우유를 마시고 있습니까? [Nutrition education 5] Does the child drink low-fat milk instead of regular milk? 2021 I7Q_SFT_Q2_VF1507 [문진21] 안전보행을 위해 아이를 계속 지도합니까? [Questionnaire 21] Do you keep teaching the child to walk safely? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q6_VF2104 [영양교육6. 아이가 매일 다양한 잡곡, 채소, 과일을 섭취하고 있습니까? [Nutrition education 6] Does the child eat a variety of grains, vegetables, and fruits every day? 2021 I7Q_SFT_Q3_VF1507 [문진22] 아이가 자전거, (인라인)스케이트 등을 탈 때에 헬멧과 보호 장구를 착용합니까? [Questionnaire 22] Does the child wear a helmet and protective gear when riding a bicycle or (inline) skates? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q7_VF2104 [영양교육7. 아이가 간식이나 외식 시 달고 짜고 기름진 인스턴트 식품이나 패스트푸드를 자주 먹습니까?(예를 들어 과자, 아이스크림, 햄버거, 치킨, 과자 등) [Nutrition education 7] Does the child often eat sweet, salty, or fatty instant or fast food as snacks or when eating out (for example snacks, ice cream, hamburgers, fried chicken)? 2021 I7Q_SFT_Q4_VF1507 [문진23] 불났을 때, 아이가 대피하는 방법을 알고 있습니까? [Questionnaire 23] Does the child know how to evacuate in a fire? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q8_VF2104 [영양교육8. 아이가 학습 외 목적으로 TV, 동영상, 스마트폰, 컴퓨터, 게임 등을 하는 시간이 하루 2시간 이상입니까? [Nutrition education 8] Does the child spend 2 hours or more a day on TV, videos, smartphones, computers, or games for purposes other than learning? 2021 I7Q_SFT_Q5_VF1507 [문진24] 모르는 사람이 도와달라고 할 때, 아이가 어떻게 해야 할지 가르쳐줍니까? [Questionnaire 24] Do you teach the child what to do when a stranger asks for help? 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q9_VF2104 [영양교육9. 아이가 하루 1시간 이상 숨차고 땀이 날 정도로 뛰어 놀거나 운동을 합니까? [Nutrition education 9] Does the child run, play, or exercise enough to be out of breath and sweat for 1 hour or more a day? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q1_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q3_VF2104 [취학전준비교육3. 아이가 다른 친구들과 잘 어울려 놉니까? (예: 아이가 친구와 놀면서 양보할 줄 압니까?) [School readiness 3] Does the child play well with other friends (for example, can the child yield while playing)? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q2_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q1_VF2104 [취학전준비교육1. 아이가 어린이집이나 유치원의 수업 시간 동안에 한 자리에 앉아 있을 수 있습니까? [School readiness 1] Can the child stay seated during class time at daycare or kindergarten? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q3_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q4_VF2104 [취학전준비교육4. 아이가 어른의 지시를 따르고 부모님이나 선생님이 정해준 규칙을 지킵니까? [School readiness 4] Does the child follow adult instructions and the rules set by parents or teachers? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q4_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q8_VF2104 [취학전준비교육8. 아이가 대소변을 보고 난 뒤, 본인이 혼자서 처리할 수 있습니까? [School readiness 8] Can the child handle toileting alone afterward? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q5_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q6_VF2104 [취학전준비교육6. 아이가 도움이 필요할 때 다른 사람에게 도움을 요청할 수 있습니까? [School readiness 6] Can the child ask others for help when needed? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q6_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q2_VF2104 [취학전준비교육2. 아이가 자고 일어나는 시간이 규칙적입니까? [School readiness 2] Does the child go to bed and wake up at regular times? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q7_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q5_VF2104 [취학전준비교육5. 아이가 자신이 하고자 하는 말을 분명하고 조리 있게 말할 수 있습니까? [School readiness 5] Can the child say what they want to say clearly and coherently? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q8_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q7_VF2104 [취학전준비교육7. 아이가 숫자를 20까지 세고 손가락으로 한 자릿수 덧셈을 할 수 있습니까? [School readiness 7] Can the child count to 20 and add single-digit numbers with the fingers? 2021 I7Q_PRSCH_Q9_VF1507 취학준비문진 School readiness questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_PRSCH_Q9_VF2104 [취학전준비교육9. 아이가 산만하거나 집중력이 떨어진다고 생각하십니까? [School readiness 9] Do you think the child is distracted or has poor concentration? 2021 I7Q_NTR_Q1_VF1507 [문진27] 아이가 아침 식사는 꼭 하는 편입니까? [Questionnaire 27] Does the child usually eat breakfast? 2007-2017 I7Q_SNT_Q1_VF2104 [개인위생교육 1. 아이가 만6세 이전에 받아야 하는 모든 정기 예방접종을 완료 하였습니까? [Hygiene education 1] Has the child completed all routine vaccinations due before age 6? 2021 I7Q_NTR_Q2_VF1507 [문진28] 아이가 매일 밖에서 하는 놀이 활동은 몇 시간 입니까? [Questionnaire 28] Hours of outdoor play per day 2007-2017 I7Q_SNT_Q2_VF2104 [개인위생교육 2. 아이가 기침이나 재채기를 할 때에 무엇으로 가리고 합니까? [Hygiene education 2] What does the child cover the mouth with when coughing or sneezing? 2021 I7Q_NTR_Q3_VF1507 [문진29] 일주일 동안 온 가족이 함께 하는 저녁 식사는 몇 번 입니까? [Questionnaire 29] How many dinners a week does the whole family eat together? 2007-2017 I7Q_SNT_Q3_VF2104 [개인위생교육 3. 아이가 코를 풀거나 손으로 가리고 기침이나 재채기를 한 경우 항상 손을 씻도록 가르칩니까? [Hygiene education 3] Do you teach the child to always wash hands after blowing the nose or coughing or sneezing into the hands? 2021 I7Q_NTR_Q4_VF1507 [문진30] 아이가 하루에 칼슘이 함유된 유제품(우유, 요구르트, 치즈 등 포함)을 먹는 횟수는 몇 번 입니까? [Questionnaire 30] How many times a day does the child eat calcium-rich dairy (milk, yogurt, cheese)? 2007-2017 I7Q_CMN_Q1_VF2104 [문진공통. 영유아 건강검진은 영유아의 정상적인 성장과 발달을 확인하는 것이 목적이며, 특정 질환의 발견을 위한 것이 아닙니다. 이 사실을 이해하셨습니까? [Common questionnaire] Do you understand that the infant health screening aims to check normal growth and development, not to detect specific diseases? 2021 I7Q_NTR_Q5_1_VF1507 [문진31] 평상시 아이가 먹는 간식에 관한 질문입니다. ①3 끼 식사이외에 간식은 잘 먹지 않는다. [Questionnaire 31] Child's usual snacks, 1 rarely snacks besides three meals 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q5_2_VF1507 [문진31] 평상시 아이가 먹는 간식에 관한 질문입니다. ②간식으로 과일 먹는 것을 좋아하지 않는다. [Questionnaire 31] Child's usual snacks, 2 does not like fruit as a snack 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q5_3_VF1507 [문진31] 평상시 아이가 먹는 간식에 관한 질문입니다. ③패스트푸드(햄버거, 파자, 라면)를 즐겨 먹는다. [Questionnaire 31] Child's usual snacks, 3 often eats fast food (hamburgers, pizza, ramen) 2007-2017 I7Q_NTR_Q6_VF1507 영양문진 Nutrition questionnaire 2007-2017 I7Q_CMN_Q1_VF1701 [문진공통] 영유아 건강검진은 영유아의 정상적인 성장과 발달을 확인하는 것이 목적이며, 특정 질환의 발견을 위한 것이 아닙니다. 이 사실을 이해하셨습니까?(1:예,2:아니오) [Common questionnaire] Do you understand that the infant health screening aims to check normal growth and development, not to detect specific diseases? MDRD formula 186 × (serum creatinine)^-1.154 × (age)^-0.203 (× 0.742 for women); when creatinine is calibrated to standardized reference material, the IDMS-traceable MDRD formula 175 × (serum creatinine)^-1.154 × (age)^-0.203 (× 0.742 for women) is used 2014-2023 Q_SMK_YN 흡연여부 ※ 1: 현재흡연, 2: 과거흡연, 3: 비흡연 Smoking status (1 current smoker, 2 former smoker, 3 never smoker) 2014-2023 Q_DRK 주간음주횟수 ※ 0~7일 Drinking days per week (0 to 7) 2014-2023 Q_PA_VD 1주일 간 고강도 신체활동 일수 ※ 0~7일 (달리기, 에어로빅, 빠른 속도로 자전거 타기, 건설 현장 노동, 계단으로 물건 나르기 등) Days of vigorous physical activity in a week, 0 to 7 (running, aerobics, fast cycling, construction work, carrying loads upstairs) 2014-2023 Q_PA_MD 1주일 간 중강도 신체활동 일수 ※ 0~7일 (빠르게 걷기, 복식 테니스, 보통 속도로 자전거 타기, 가벼운 물건 나르기, 청소 등) Days of moderate physical activity in a week, 0 to 7 (brisk walking, doubles tennis, cycling at normal speed, carrying light loads, cleaning) 2014-2023 Q_PA_WALK 1주일 간 걷기 신체활동 일수 ※ 0~7일(2017년까지 존재) (가벼운 운동, 출퇴근이나 여가 시간에 걷기 등) Days of walking in a week, 0 to 7 (through 2017; light exercise, walking to work or in leisure time) 2014-2023 Q_PA_MUSL 1주일 간 근력운동 일수 ※ 0~7일(2018년부터 존재) (팔굽혀펴기, 윗몸일으키기, 아령, 역기, 철봉 등) Days of muscle-strengthening exercise in a week, 0 to 7 (from 2018; push-ups, sit-ups, dumbbells, barbells, pull-ups) 2014-2023

Background on sampling, versions, and linkage is on the dataset page.
